selection: All 18 continuous MATCH/noise1 parents, first three normal and first three persistent parents by ID; no outcome-based selection
baseline: Reuse sealed C01 R11 predictions after copied-code parity check; baseline not retuned
bank: Same five conditional R/X particles, native terminal map, cached prefix fit and operators per record
scoring: Only replace truncated-Gaussian amplitude log integral increments by bounded profile log-likelihood increments in live updates, retrospective birth replay and outer model scoring. Fixed prior cell weights/hazards, conditional Bayesian means/variances and all screens remain unchanged.
profile_limit: Profile arm remains a normalized penalized hypothesis-score system; it is not a posterior, not a pure GLR, not an ablation of all Bayesian state estimation. This isolates amplitude evidence scoring.
memory: At each internally inferred OFF commit set first 114 estimated physical-state deviations to zero; retain instrumental/AR state, covariance regime, theta weights, thresholds and reporting clocks. Simulated state and observations never reset.
memory_limit: Tests physical-state carry at inferred closure, not every form of temporal memory or all recovery histories before closure.
primary: unmatched alarms per full event-record hour
secondary: diagnosis/restoration delay with omissions and censoring
uncertainty: 10000 paired parent bootstrap; descriptive posthoc intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted superiority test
failure_policy: Retain all intended records and failures; do not replace or tune after outcomes
tensor: Dense physical bank unchanged; M/DeltaM are summaries. No tensor speed/accuracy claim tested.
